metadata.title: Virtualization Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for providing secure, isolated, and trustworthy execution of multiple workloads on shared physical computing platforms.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Virtualized computing platforms, hypervisor-managed infrastructure, and shared host execution environments.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for establishing isolation, trust boundaries, and safe multi-tenant operation on hypervisor-mediated compute platforms.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Virtualization trust assumes an explicitly trusted physical host substrate.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Privilege escalation risks inherent to shared virtualized execution substrates.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Lateral movement risks between co-resident virtual machines.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Defense evasion techniques operating below the guest operating system.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Guest-to-host or hypervisor escape via exploitation for privilege escalation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Remote services and shared host services enabling inter-VM lateral movement.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Execution isolation enforced at the hypervisor layer.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Verification of platform and hypervisor integrity.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Reduction of hypervisor attack surface available to guest workloads.

metadata.remarks: Virtualization Core defines the foundational trust properties required to safely operate multiple workloads on a shared physical host using a hypervisor. This pattern makes isolation guarantees, trust boundaries, and virtualization-layer threat relevance explicit and assertable.

components.title: Virtual Machine Isolation
components.description: Prevents unauthorized interaction or interference between virtual machines.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Compromise of one virtual machine does not enable access to other co-resident workloads.

components.title: Host–Guest Trust Boundary
components.description: Maintains strict separation between guest workloads and the host system.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Guest workloads cannot influence or escape into the host or hypervisor execution context.

components.title: Lateral Movement Containment
components.description: Limits the ability of a compromised guest to move laterally across shared virtual infrastructure.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Hypervisor-mediated controls reduce lateral attack paths between virtual machines.
